summary: A Quote client on an equity whose tk snapshot carries no average price, trade quantity, book totals or OI: the Quote frame leaves them out rather than sending 0. A tf delta then brings a new price and a buy total without a feed time: the total appears and the feed time, which the partial update did not change, stays as on the web; the next delta with a time brings it.

notes: A tf leaves out what has not changed: docs/port/market-data-frames.md, Partial-update feeds; lead correction 2026-11-09, .lane/107/decisions.md: a field a partial packet omits is unchanged, not unknown.
The review's coverage table asks AliceBlue for an absent-field sequence.
AliceBlue (Noren) leaves a field it has no value for out of tk and tf.

deviations.reason: The web sends AliceBlue's feed time ft unchanged as ltt: epoch seconds, and a string ("1794302700"); the protocol's WebSocket timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), so the unit is wrong, as for Dhan. The desktop sends the trade time in ms, as a number.

The web's Quote sends average_price 0.0, then 0, for a tick whose snapshot never carried ap (parsed_data.get("average_price", 0.0)); a value the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md).
The web's Quote sends total_oi 0 for an equity whose ticks carry no toi; a value the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md).

AliceBlue's tick carries last_quantity (ltq); the web's mapper never reads it (aliceblue_mapping.py:111-217), so its Quote leaves out a value the broker sent (lost data, lead ruling 2026-11-09). The desktop sends it.

AliceBlue's tick carries total_buy_quantity (tbq); the web's mapper never reads it (aliceblue_mapping.py:111-217), so its Quote leaves out a value the broker sent (lost data, lead ruling 2026-11-09). The desktop sends it.
